title: AMIF: Authorizable Medical Image Fusion Model with Built-in Authentication
description:
arXiv:2603.24296v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multimodal medical image fusion integrates complementary anatomical and functional information from different imaging modalities, providing richer image representations for clinical interpretation and assisted diagnosis. High-performance medical image fusion models are typically built upon medical images with high data sensitivity and security requirements, together with carefully designed algorithmic architectures. Collectively, these constitute intellectual property of significant value. As fusion results are circulated and reused in scenarios such as cross-institutional collaboration, traceable copyright protection and controlled authorization for these medical fusion assets are becoming increasingly important. However, existing multimodal medical image fusion models typically generate unprotected results and lack built-in copyright protection and authorization mechanisms. Conventional post-processing watermarking is independent of the fusion model, making it difficult for copyright protection to become an intrinsic capability of the model itself. To address this issue, we propose AMIF, the first Authorizable Medical Image Fusion model with built-in authentication, which integrates authorization access control into the image fusion objective. For unauthorized usage, AMIF embeds explicit and visible copyright identifiers into fusion results. In contrast, high-quality fusion results are accessible upon successful key-based authentication.
